name: QUARTET
author: keste
description: A physical-modelling string quartet for VIBE FM: four slots, sixteen bowed-string voices and one clean-room C waveguide after McIntyre / Schumacher / Woodhouse (the STK Bowed model). Eight presets cover solo and section strings, bass and octobass. Each slot has one of 14 articulations: sustained vibrato/non-vibrato, legato, portamento, staccato, spiccato, tremolo, pizzicato, harmonics, trill, sul tasto, sul ponticello, marcato and double stops. Keys and MIDI play only the selected slot; pads and the demo sound all four. Effects: adjustable reverb, stereo chorus, clean delay and two-tap echo. Pads 1-16 fire original Stravinsky-style chords; F3/PLAY runs a four-part arrangement of the supplied MIDI riff. No samples, no impulse responses, no heap.
